diagnosis: The earlier source-original omission retained exact fallback files but removed original URLs from worker metadata. Offline requests to an unknown original URL fell through to the network and rejected TypeError, so strict404-only readers could not reach the cached fallback.
fix: The publication selector reports only actually omitted, exact-pinned paths through a local optional callback. The builder emits a nonempty omittedSourceOriginals field only for that profile. The worker rejects unsafe, oversized, duplicated or retained-path collisions and returns local404 only for same-scope GET requests on those deliberate omissions. Existing cache authorization, no-store bypass, readers, integrity checks and cancellation remain unchanged.
limitations: The actual Chromium probe uses two representative descriptors and the real worker template with a small selector-approved download inventory; it is not full emitted-site installation or navigation qualification.
Browser cache bodies/metadata and local/session storage stayed byte-identical across reads. VM tests additionally assert no worker cache.put calls. This is not a heap or exhaustive IndexedDB audit.
The complete emitted worker/config list and full-release field absence are being checked separately by the packaging owner.

Production preview already used cache:no-store for original requests before this omission change. The definite newly introduced regression is the omitted Current Art original path; this remedy also makes the shared Production fallback reachable offline without broad network-error fallback.
